purpose: Describe the small Google Analytics measurement used on Mythical Void's public website. The tag is not part of the game. It starts with analytics and advertising storage turned off, asks visitors before enabling analytics, counts a canonical public-page visit only after an affirmative choice, and can record only two allowlisted public actions: choosing a Play link or choosing the Share button. Each action includes only a broad page group. Mythical does not send a name, age, child detail, account number, email, creature identity, save, story choice, full URL, query string, raw referrer, button wording, user ID, advertising ID, or gameplay event. Advertising and Google Signals remain off. The production source and routes are verified, but the resulting numbers are not company truth until Google property access, receipt, retention, and reporting are checked.

meaning.public_play_selected: A visitor who allowed analytics activated a public website link to the game. This is a selection event, not proof that the game loaded or that a person played.
meaning.public_share_selected: A visitor who allowed analytics activated the public Share button. This is a selection event, not proof that sharing completed.

nextDecision: Kevin should later confirm the Google Analytics property owner, who can remove the tag, the chosen retention setting, and access to the reports. A trusted reporting check should then prove that consented public page views and the two allowlisted action names arrive with only a broad page_group, while game routes produce no analytics. Until that check is recorded, the code may collect consented public-website measurements but no dashboard number should be treated as a player, a child, a successful game load, a completed share, or a company performance result. If an unexpected field, advertising feature, gameplay event, or unapproved route appears, disable the tag and investigate before using the data.
